names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Μάξιμος και Ολυμπιάδα οι Μάρτυρες», with the rank word left off.

death.note: The reign the page prints as the date, as the folder's own life has it: «martyred in Persia in the years of the emperor Decius, which it dates 249 to 251».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Μάξιμος και Ολυμπιάδα οι Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and is one sentence long. Two names in one line, so two folders. It gives neither of them a year: it sets them only «κατά τους χρόνους του αυτοκράτορα Δεκίου (249-251 μ.Χ.)», a reign and not a date, so there is no `dates` object. The corpus holds a dozen others of this name and none of them is kept on this day or in Persia. The page prints no hymn and no couplet.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
